correctness.rationale: Reproduced the full census using a source-subset Bellman recurrence, not the uploaded breadth-first implementations. Start with one empty word on each singleton and no solved nonsingleton. At depth d each previously unsolved subset receives the sum of counts at the first layer d−1 of its two labeled images. A shortest word must have a shortest suffix from its image, and distinct first letters always give distinct words even for coincident transitions. Freeze a subset on first nonzero arrival. No shortest path repeats a nonsingleton subset, so 26 layers suffice; a stalled frontier cannot recover. Enumerated all 3125 maps and all pairs with a≤b, weighting diagonal pairs by 1 and others by 2 because letter interchange preserves length and count. All 14 multiplicity frequencies and all 48 threshold/unique/word-sum cells match the frozen data, including 8,063,385 synchronizing, 1,702,240 not, 5,071,440 unique, and 240 extremizers at length 13 with 64 shortest words. Directly evaluated every binary word through depth 13 for the witness: exactly the stated six-choice pattern, all targeting state 0, with coefficients 1,6,15,20,15,6,1 starting at degree 4. The actual list of extremal pairs equals the orbit generated by conjugation and letter swap. Reproduction code and merged output are in /workspace/branches/review3_census.py and /workspace/branches/review3_census.out; 25 blocks cover first-map identifiers [0,3125). The source package was inspected, not executed.
residual_risks: Enumeration is specifically for ordered labeled transition pairs on five states. The frozen reverse implementation uses %llu for uint64_t without casts, which is nonportable where uint64_t is unsigned long; the independent exact reproduction does not rely on its output or on any C++ compiler.

value.rationale: Multiplicity distinguishes optimization degeneracy invisible in the familiar small-automata reset-threshold census. This is a complete labeled population rather than a slice selected for a numerical anomaly, and the sharp maximum has an explicit six-choice language and one exact orbit. The data show that longest minimal length and largest multiplicity have different extremizers (the 240 length-16 automata all have unique shortest words). The histogram and witnessed extremal configuration are reusable base cases and discriminating benchmarks for shortest-reset algorithms.
residual_risks: The exact finite classification does not predict multiplicity or thresholds at larger state counts.
